source_input_sha256_scheme: FIELDS insertion order, then chronological frame; then chronological controls. For each full source file: UTF8(relative filename)+NUL, uint64 little-endian byte length, original file bytes. Includes source pixels outside the exported crop; does not claim a whole-capture input hash.
source_hash_scope: Every exported source file was hashed in full and checked against its capture image hash when available. Exact crop byte hashes are also stored. Camera word arrays are attested by the capture manifest hash.
purpose: Dry CPU research fixture, not a converged reference, game final output, or executable RR replay fixture. Albedos are not included.

coordinate_contract.pixel_convention: local integer pixel centers; the +0.5 terms cancel in correspondence
coordinate_contract.motion_rg: original physical full-render UV; previous minus current; no crop scaling or extra jitter applied
coordinate_contract.previous_local_formula: q_previous_local = current_local + crop_origin_render[t] + input_motion[t, ..., :2] * render_extent - crop_origin_render[t-1]
coordinate_contract.valid_bilinear: finite q and 0 <= qx < width-1 and 0 <= qy < height-1; outside crop is INVALID, never clamp or wrap
coordinate_contract.first_frame: No previous fixture frame; do not loop the last frame to the first

storage_contract.radiance: original little-endian captured FP16 RGBA; input alpha contains hit distance; no gain, normalization, clipping, conversion or exposure
storage_contract.normal_roughness: original packed RGB10A2 uint32; oct normal bits0..19, linear roughness bits20..29, material bits30..31; world-space normals
storage_contract.controls: original 46 uint32 words; preserve bits and original provider frame index
storage_contract.camera_arrays: original capture uint32 IEEE-754 word encodings; .view('<f4') for numeric camera matrices/positions

material_note: Original material IDs are globally zero over all published frames of source 2405579e and 87ee1fba, as independently counted in task26. This is not a semantic material fixture; no such global claim is made for f2ef375f.
analysis_note: The bottle speed mask also includes hand/arm. The foliage band contains multiple depth/coverage surfaces. This small facade tile is not the original whole-ROI bench mask.
